[Section] Setup
[source_id=61] The shared task had two phases: In the development phase, the participants were provided labeled training and development datasets; in the testing phase, testing input was further provided.
[source_id=62] The participants tried to achieve the best performance on the development set. A live leaderboard kept track of the submissions.
[source_id=63] The test set was released and the participants had few days to make final predictions.
[source_id=64] In phase 2, no immediate feedback on the submissions was provided. The winner was determined based on the performance on the test set.
